Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name INDIA GOVERNMENT MINT (A UNIT OF SPMCIL) -COLLECTION A/C Account No. 201003484303

IFSC Code INDB0000004 Bank Name INDUSIND BANK Branch address 0004 - HYDERABAD . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) I. Scope of work: 1. Hiring of JCB with driver & fuel 2. Hiring of Tractor trolley with driver & fuel 3. Hiring of Helpers for debris lifting. 4. For ground cleaning, dressing, cleaning of drain, excavation, removal of garbage, waste and debris from v arious locations as per the direction of the officer-in-charge of Buyer organization i.e. India Government Mi nt, Hyderabad. 5. Time of services required per day: 09:00 AM to 5:30PM II. Terms & Conditions: 1. Firm has to collect and dispose off all accumulated vegetation/ earthen heaps/ unserviceable items/deb ri s etc. at the space provided by IGMH. 2. Firm should follow all safety and security rules and regulations while working at site. 3. It is the responsibility of the contractor to provide necessary/ required PPE to the deputed working labou r/ staff. Under any circumstances IGMH will not be responsible for the accidents if any. 4. Proper care should be taken during excavation/demolishing with machinery/manual, in case of any dam ag e to structure during such activities, the firm is bound to repair, rectify and restore the same with his o wn expenses. 5. The fuel, repair and maintenance of the vehicle will be in the scope of firm. 6.Contract Duration: The contract duration shall be 12 months from the date of issue of contract with ceilin g as mentioned below: 1 Hiring of JCB with driver and fuel Days 60 2 Hiring of Tractor with Trolley including with driver and fuel Days 60 3.Hiring of Helpers for debris lifting Days 120 7.Payment will be made on monthly basis upon submission of invoice and certific ation by the officer in-charge based on the actual number of days work executed with a ceiling of mentioned quantity (above point 6) 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: The bidder firm should meet following eligibility criteria to qualify:

i. For MSE/Start-up firm: The bidder must have capability to provide the relevant services. ii. For other firm - Experience and past performance: The bidder should have experience of having success fully supplied relevant services of at least Rs. 4.5 lakhs in any one of the last five years ending on ’31.03. 2026. iii. The bidder should submit signed and stamped copy of bid document as a token of acceptance of all the terms & conditions of the tender such as scope of work, payment terms, delivery period and acceptance of GCC. iv. The price quoted for each schedule in the price schedule (excel format attached) shall be fixed and fina l for the entire contract duration and same shall be considered for billing purpose. v. The service provider mandatorily shall quote as per the tender's price schedul e. A confirmation to these effect should be given in technical bid. Failing which l ead to rejection of bid. . 9. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
